sections.overview:
The seo-platform is an open-source AI-driven SEO platform that streamlines search engine optimization workflows through LLM-powered automation. It enables keyword research, competitor analysis, optimized content generation, and ranking tracking all within a single integrated system. Built by P-Essonam, the platform leverages artificial intelligence to reduce manual SEO tasks and provide data-driven insights for improving search visibility.
Conduct keyword research and analysis for target markets
Analyze competitor SEO strategies and identify opportunities
Generate SEO-optimized content at scale using AI
Monitor and track keyword rankings over time
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/P-Essonam/seo-platform`
sections.usage:

Analyze the SEO performance of [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide a comprehensive report including top-ranking keywords, competitor analysis, and content optimization suggestions. Focus on [DATA] metrics such as organic traffic, backlink profile, and domain authority.
